positioning: Drive safely. Driver assistance for every car.
store_claim: Hundreds of country-specific traffic-sign classes. Availability and supported signs vary by country and installed model.
count_scope: Country-specific model outputs, not unique signs, validated accuracy, or universal live recognition availability. Includes evaluation packs and the Swiss pack, whose rights/readiness gates remain separate.
comparison_claim: Better than most built-in systems is not used: no comparative field benchmark was found.
vehicle_scope: Any car means no vehicle integration required; a supported phone and safely mounted camera are still needed. No steering, braking or autonomous driving is claimed.

visual_review.result: All locale galleries visually reviewed. Splash captures found in French Swiss/Belgian and Dutch Belgian examples; French and Dutch country groups recaptured with expected-currency UI readiness checks and reviewed again.
visual_review.native_device_scope: Android emulator only; no physical-device deployment.
